summaries.summary: Eid pruža dva odvojena skupa api-ja, pri čemu svaki od njih služi određenoj svrsi. I pokriva specifičan opseg: za integraciju snažne autentifikacije sa kosovo wallet novčanik.

Eidapi je dostupan integratorima trećih strana koji žele da dodaju funkcionalnosti kosovo eid-a u svoje sisteme. Integrator mora biti pravno lice registrovano na kosovu i mora imati validan poslovni slučaj.

Desktop aplikacija za potpisivanje dostupna je za windows, macos i linux ( Ubuntu distribuciju) mobilna aplika za ios i android. Instalacija i korišćenje, bez ikakvih ograničenja, besplatni su u okviru sistema kosovo eid.

We provide the possibility to sign documents both on desktop or laptop as well as on mobile devices. The desktop signing app is only facilitating the signing process by ensuring the verification of the used certificate each time when is used for signature.
Dokumente iz microsoft office paketa možete potpisivati koristeći svoj eid sertifikat i digitalne pečate. Office 365 podržavaju funkcionalnosti digitalnog potp Isivanja.
Kosovo novčanik je mobilna aplikacija koja se koristi za bezbedno čuvanje kredencijala vašeg elektronskog identiteta ili vaše pečata. Instalacija, bez ikakvih ograničenja, su besplatni.
Kosovo novčanik vam pruža niz funkcionalnosti koje omogućavaju bezbedno čuvanje i zaštitu kredencijala vašeg sertifikata na uređaju.

To obtain an electronic id, you will need to go through the enrollment process at the civil registration offices (arc) for a digital seal, the process takes place at the kosovo business registration agency (arbk) for now, online enrollment is not available.

Kosovo eid is the national system that manages electronic identities for citizens of kosovo. An electronic id is a free digital certificate issued by the government of kOSOVO. With it, citizens can securely sign (or stamp) documents and access digital services.

The self service portal is the tool that allows you to manage your certificate(s) and to migrate the wallet when you change your device. To access the self-service portal you would need the certificate information that you received during the enrollment process (the certificate user name and password).
